subject: Night Passage Unlit Sovereign
review: Inspected native front, side, rear and angled clay and material views, plus all four attack contacts.
The broken orbital crown, faceless porcelain mask, silver shoulder mantle and divided violet vestments distinguish the final guardian. The first candidate needed no geometry repair after review.
Inspected six-frame-per-second decoded unretimed cross, rain, pulse and wheel playback for preparation, contact and settling; retained the full seven-clip 1x movie.
Compared production native and fallback at identical positions and crossed-lane warning geometry. The health bar clears the crown and the ground warning remains visible.
Reviewed 960x600 and 390x244 production views. Fine crown gaps and mask seam recede at narrow scale; pale head, silver shoulders and violet body carry the identity.

geometryAgreement.sampling: All 280 authored 30fps frames, 16 vertices per named mesh (432 points/frame); whole-surface native floor/IK audit is separate.

limits: Self-review is not user art approval. All four guardians are authored; four environment kits and further effects/icons remain pending.
In-place locomotion has no claim of world-space foot locking at every movement speed; directional locomotion and transition blending remain polish.
Newly loaded mid-action snapshots infer preparation duration when historic enrage timing is unavailable; contact remains tied to the confirmed attack transition.
Six-fps decoded review samples motion; it is not an exhaustive continuous-time anatomical proof.

delegation.ownership: Primary authored native source and integrated/reviewed delivery; two reused workers owned runtime/tests and browser/receipt checks.
delegation.rework: Workers generalized six-clip test assumptions and verified four-pattern wraparound. Both outputs passed integration checks; no native geometry repair was needed.
delegation.efficiency: Both delegated outputs were used. No measured single-agent time comparison.
